title: V2 Provider Metadata Model Entry
description: Model-level metadata under provider manifest metadata.models. Integer capacity fields use 0 for unknown. Per-model capability facts (model_capabilities / modalities) are Experimental (PT-ME-001 / ME-001): omitted keys mean unknown — never treat as false. Distinct from provider-level capabilities.required/optional advertisements.

release_date.description: Model release or GA date (ISO 8601 date)

status.description: Operational status of this model entry

pricing.description: Optional per-model pricing hints (not a substitute for pricing.json). May include cache_write_per_1m / tiers when known.

thinking.description: Optional thinking/reasoning mode label (e.g. dual_mode). Orthogonal to model_capabilities.reasoning (boolean support).

architecture.description: Optional model architecture hints (e.g. moe total/active).

model_capabilities.description: Experimental (PT-ME-001). Per-model capability facts. Omitted property = unknown (not false). When present, prefer these over provider capabilities.required/optional ads for this model.

tool_call.description: Whether this model supports tool/function calling. Omit if unknown.

structured_output.description: Whether this model supports JSON/schema-constrained output. Omit if unknown.

reasoning.description: Whether this model supports extended reasoning/thinking. Omit if unknown. See also thinking for mode labels.

attachment.description: Whether this model accepts non-text attachments (image/file/etc.). Prefer modalities.input when more precise. Omit if unknown.

modalities.description: Experimental (PT-ME-001). Per-model input/output modalities. Prefer over provider-level multimodal when present.

reasoning_options.description: Experimental (PT-ME-001). Optional reasoning control shapes (effort/toggle/budget). Structure may evolve; additionalProperties allowed on items.

family.description: Experimental (PT-ME-001). Model family/series label for grouping (e.g. deepseek-flash).

knowledge_cutoff.description: Experimental (PT-ME-001). Knowledge cutoff label (e.g. 2025-05). Not a hard guarantee.

open_weights.description: Experimental (PT-ME-001). Whether model weights are openly available. Omit if unknown.

source.description: Provenance of verification evidence. Application or deployment names (eos, velaclaw, etc.) are forbidden — see docs/MANIFEST_AUTHORITY.md.
